executor_pre_run_derivation.status: executor derivation written before any computation; NOT a hypothesis band; recorded so it cannot be fitted after the fact
executor_pre_run_derivation.claim: For S_3(u, x, z) with z a nonzero constant, the F_2-linear functional lambda = Tr(beta * .) with beta = z^-2 applied to the n descended coordinates cancels the whole quadratic part: quadratic part of S_3 is (ux)^2 + z(ux), and Tr(beta w^2) + Tr(beta z w) = Tr((beta^(1/2) + beta z) w) = 0 for all w iff beta = z^-2. The resulting combination is affine: Tr(u) + Tr(x) + Tr(B z^-2) (with x in V). Hence a nonzero degree<=1 polynomial lies in the row space of M_2.
executor_pre_run_derivation.consequence_under_frozen_rule: If confirmed, the O-DFF-ANOMALY condition (d_ff < 4 on rebuilt generators) is triggered at every primary instance; this is consistent with KN-FIND-006's 'subset-sum of descended quadrics degenerates to an affine form'.
